title: Grateful Dead Live at Onondaga County War Memorial on 1973-09-17

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of decent quality captures a unique 1973 show where horns joined the Dead for an energetic second set featuring standout Truckin' and Weather Report Suite moments.
ai_review.review: The SBD capture is clear enough to enjoy the unusual horn‑filled second set, which many fans describe as high‑energy and experimental. Highlights include Keith Godchaux’s fiery jam on “Truckin’,” a memorable “Sugar Magnolia” vocal line from Jerry, and an expansive Weather Report Suite, while the horns divide opinion. Recording quality is solid with no major flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and praise the performance; a few 3‑star reviews note personal dislike of horns but no serious technical issues, leading to an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers mention good sound quality and no major dropouts; the venue’s acoustics are noted as poor but that does not affect the SBD clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set is distinctive for the unexpected horn section on Wake of the Flood material, creating an experimental yet effective flow that many fans remember vividly.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry sings a memorable line from “Sugar Magnolia” that reviewers singled out.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux’s energetic jam on “Truckin'” is praised as a highlight.
